description: This Java source file defines the class DragFrameLayout, a custom FrameLayout that enables drag-and-drop positioning of child views. It manages draggable views, integrates with ViewDragHelper to handle touch interactions, and notifies a controller interface about drag events.

classes.name: DragFrameLayout
classes.description: A custom FrameLayout subclass that allows child views to be draggable within the layout, utilizing ViewDragHelper for gesture handling and providing an interface for drag event notifications.

methods.name: DragFrameLayout
methods.description: Constructors initializing the DragFrameLayout with various parameter options and setting up the drag helper and draggable views list.

methods.name: onInterceptTouchEvent
methods.description: Intercepts touch events to determine whether to start drag handling based on user interaction.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Processes touch events through the ViewDragHelper to manage dragging behavior.

methods.name: addDragView
methods.description: Adds a child view to the list of views that can be dragged within the layout.

methods.name: setDragFrameController
methods.description: Sets the controller interface instance to notify about drag start and end events.
